description: This file defines the ClientCredentials class within the League\OAuth2\Client\Grant namespace, representing a client credentials grant in OAuth2 authentication. It extends an abstract grant class and implements methods to provide the grant's name and request parameters.

classes.name: ClientCredentials
classes.description: Represents a client credentials grant for OAuth2, extending AbstractGrant and providing specific implementation for grant name and required parameters.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string 'client_credentials' representing the name of the grant.

methods.name: getRequiredRequestParameters
methods.description: Returns an empty array indicating no additional request parameters are required for this grant.
